{{Quote|Any ship going there must first dock with Imperial Station 003 in orbit over Coruscant|[[Edmon Rampart]] explains how to find Tantiss Base|<ref name="Breach" />}}
'''Imperial Station 003''',<ref name="Breach Sub">{{TBB|Into the Breach}} {{Subtitles|Disney+}}</ref> also known as the '''Orbital Space''', was a [[space station]] orbiting<ref name="DBSpaceStation" /> the [[Galactic Empire]]’s [[capital]] [[planet]]<ref name="Coruscant">{{Databank|coruscant|Coruscant}}</ref> [[Coruscant]].<ref name="DBSpaceStation" /> Similar in appearance to an enlarged [[ICM-092792]] construction module,<ref name="Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]''</ref> it hosted multiple [[hangar]] bays and could dock up to eight [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]s in external docking arms.<ref name="Identity" /> 

During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|310}}</ref> the station was guarded by several [[clone commando]]s and [[TK stormtrooper]]s and used to collect [[Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling|children]] captured from around [[the galaxy]] by certain class one [[bounty hunter]]s. The children were exchanged with a case of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] in the station's hangars and were then transported to the [[Advanced Science Division]]'s [[Tantiss Base]] for experimentation. The station was also the penultimate destination for any ship going to Tantiss Base, as they had their crew and cargo inspected before being given clearance to depart where the coordinates were transmitted directly to the starships' [[navigation computer]] via a secure link to allow them to perform a [[hyperspace]] jump to [[Wayland]] without the crew learning of its location as one of the safeguards [[Chief Scientist]] [[Doctor]] [[Royce Hemlock]] put in place to keep it secret.<ref name="Identity" />
